statement: Linux standalone Python contracts run in a separate Ubuntu 24.04 job with a 20-minute timeout and the GCC draft guard. Dependency installation and the standalone plan retain documentation-only, mixed and uncertain Python classification coverage. GCC shards retain their 60-minute limits and no longer run the standalone plan. The required Linux / GCC aggregate waits for the Python job and rejects any unsuccessful or skipped Python result and unsuccessful classification. Windows standalone placement is unchanged.
